messages:
Viktor H: quick sync — packaging Datadog + OpenTelemetry guidance for the HW marketplace tile. need an ops & privacy checklist before we ship.
Claire Z: ok. what are the partners mandatory observability asks?
Viktor H: they want spans that include model_family, model_id, batch_size, and quant_label. they also want a compact dashboard tile for p50/p95 and a tail errors panel.
Mateo R: model_id is fine. quant_label is risky for cardinality; suggestion: emit quant_label only when != "fp16" and map to a coarse quant_class tag for indexing.
Jia L: agree. also add model_family as a low-cardinality resource attr. batch_size can be an int span attr.
Claire Z: sampling policy? partner requests low baseline sampling but full capture on errors and slow traces (>550ms). OTEL tail_sampling + local rate limiter should do it.
Viktor H: please include a minimal OTEL snippet in the bundle we give partners.
Mateo R: snippet to include:
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  tail_sampling:
    policies:
      - name: errors
        type: string_attribute
        string_attribute:
          key: "error"
          values: ["true"]
      - name: slow_traces
        type: latency
        latency:
          threshold_ms: 550
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: ${DD_API_KEY}
```
Jia L: add note: index dd.trace_id in logs to enable jump-to-trace; index model_family but do not index quant_label.
Viktor H: marketplace requires a dashboard naming convention. propose: `Marketplace / Integrations / <PartnerName> / Model / <model_family> / Inference Metrics`. keeps things predictable.
Claire Z: will draft dashboard JSON with tiles: p50, p95, tail_error_rate, qps. include Datadog example query for trace linking.
Mateo R: example Datadog metric query: `avg:trace.inference.latency{model_family:resnet}.rollup(p95)` and recommend saving a widget that filters by model_family.
Jia L: ops runbook items to include: logrotate sample, collector disk retention (traces 7d, metrics 30d), and fallback: switch to metric-only aggregation if high-card spans degrade dashboards.
Viktor H: demo & QA: can we run a dry-run with partner Wed 11am PT? also include telemetry loadgen link for QA.
Claire Z: yes to Wed 11am PT. loadgen repo: https://git.internal/redwood/obs-loadgen (see /scripts/run_mixed_load.sh).
infra-bot: Calendar invite created: 'Marketplace obs dry-run' Wed 11:00 PT Attendees: Viktor H, Claire Z, Mateo R, Jia L.
legal-bot: Noted. Looping in legal for the joint announcement blurb once PR is ready.
Viktor H: final deliverables: OTEL config snippet, dashboard JSON, runbook blurb, demo recording link, and a short privacy note about PII avoidance in spans. I'll open the PR after dry-run. thanks all :thumbsup:
